issues.title: Hardcoded Credential
issues.message: A hardcoded credential was detected in the source code.
issues.recommendation: Store credentials in environment variables or a secure secret manager instead of embedding them in code.

issues.title: Use of os.system()
issues.message: os.system() executes shell commands and may lead to command injection.
issues.recommendation: Prefer subprocess.run() without shell=True or safer APIs.

issues.title: Weak MD5 Hash Algorithm
issues.message: MD5 is cryptographically broken and should not be used for security-sensitive purposes.
issues.recommendation: Use SHA-256, SHA-3, or another modern cryptographic hash function instead.
